Results.ReviewText: Downsizing in family size, big enough to feed 8 and small enough for 2
Results.Title: Perfect for downsizing

Results.ReviewText: This is one of the best charcoal grills I have ever owned. It's very easy to keep the temperature regulated and takes no time to clean.
Results.Title: Great grill.

Results.ReviewText: Best grill on the market.  Low maintenence, durable,  straight forward grilling.  With the design of the kettle grill, smoking is a breeze too. Love my Weber!
Results.Title: Can't be beat!

Results.ReviewText: I went the barrel way for a while but Nothing cooks like a Weber Kettle!!!
Results.Title: Love my Kettle!

Results.ReviewText: I received this beautiful grill for Father's Day from my son. It came damaged by the carrier and made grilling not as enjoyable as I would  have liked. When the support people i.e. Cecilia learned of this she resolved the issue. I now have a grill that should function as is intended by WEBER. I can't wait to use it and have the enjoyable experience that comes along with grilling with a charcoal grill. WEBER is who they are because of the superior quality personnel that they employ. Quality personnel provide great quality products with the added superior support that will ensure that the customer is taken care of should the need arise. I look forward to many wonderful years of grilling with my WEBER!!!!!!!!!!!!
Results.Title: WEBER GRILL/ WEBER SUPPORT

ClientResponses.Response: Hi! Thank you for being a long time Weber fan! We greatly appreciate you taking the time to provide your feedback regarding the Original Kettle premium. We have passed along your feedback to the appropriate people. We do have a lid holder accessory that can be added to the kettle. It does not require any hardware. We have sent an email to you to discuss this further. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: This is my 3rd Weber Kettle Grill.  I had the 2 previous ones for about 20 years each.  I doubt this one will last as long.  The ash catcher seems to be a cheaper and flimsy design when compared to my 2 previous grills.  Plus, I did not realize it did not come with the lid holder as my two previous grills had.  The lid has a catch, but it is extremely hard to use.  Plus, there are no holes drilled into the new Weber so I could add the lid holder.  This is a major dram back too.  Otherwise, I love the green color, it was easy to put together and it has worked well.
Results.Title: Not as Good as Past Grills

ClientResponses.Response: Hi! Thank you for being a long time Weber fan! We greatly appreciate your feedback regarding the missing part and we will pass this along. We are happy to hear one of our reps has placed the order for the part. Please reach out to our support team if you need anything further. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: Haven't had a chance to cook w/the grill yet but when it arrived the ring that is attached below the grill, to hold the ash container, hadn't been welded so it couldn't be installed -- which I learned after spending an 90 minutes trying to install the unwelded part.  Luckily, you have 7 day a week support and they got a replacement part to me later that week.
Results.Title: Faulty Parts Received

Results.OriginalProductName: Barbecue au charbon Original Kettle Premium 22 po

Results.ReviewText: I keep this model grill in my repertoire. My last one lasted me 12 years. Perfect grill!
Results.Title: Original Kettle Premium charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: It's a Great grill!  that's why i bought it. perfect condition when when it arrived.
Results.Title: It's a Weber!

Results.ReviewText: We love all Weber products! This grill is awesome! We love having the temperature guage on top, and the one touch cleaning is a wonderful feature.
Results.Title: Weber for the win!

Results.ReviewText: Really easy to use and makes some good barbecue!!!
Results.Title: Great grill @ a reasonable price.

Results.ReviewText: Great quality, easy to put together. I like this size for my family of 5. Plenty of room for a crowd of people!
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText:
I store my Weber grill in my tightly-spaced garage which, after 40 years in the house, I still manage to park two SUV's in it!  Anyway, if I remove the lid and the cooking and charcoal grates, the grill is light enough that I can lift it up and around one of the SUV's to the outside of the garage.  Voila!
     The overlap of the lid and bowl is quite shallow so I keep a hand on the lid handle when rolling the grill.  And, possibly due to my still being in the "honeymoon phase" of owning my new grill, I don't feel comfortable hanging the lid by the lid hook.  So, when I remove the lid from the bowl I straddle it between two 2x4's placed on the concrete driveway.  I would hate to have it go "clanging" around on the concrete getting all dented and scraped up.  Ouch!
Results.Title: Weber (charcoal): 'tis Nobler than Gas

Results.ReviewText: I have zero complaints. The grill shipped quickly with no damage. Assembly was a breeze. And it works perfectly.
Results.Title: Happy Customer

ClientResponses.Response: Congratulations on your new grill! We appreciate your honest feedback, and we are sure to pass along your suggestions. We hope that you get many great meals off of your grill! If you have any questions or concerns, please let us know! Keep on grilling!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Results.ReviewText: I love the disposable ash container.  On the 22 in. The lid is very heavy and the grill itself is too deep.  Would love an extra shelf to move charcoal closer to meat for small grilling.  Need a lot of charcoal to grill two steaks.  I would have bought the 19 in if it had disposable ash container.
Results.Title: New big grill

Results.ReviewText: My family and I absolutely love it! I forgot how much I loved the charcoal flavoring in foods. The heat shield for the handle really works great! I know people who have Weber grills without that and you can’t hardly touch the handle.
Results.Title: Weber Charcoal Grill

Results.ReviewText: Love it! Works great and cooks well. Just didnt get the silicon heat protector for the top damper. So I use tongs to open and close it not to burn myself.
Results.Title: Awesome charcoal gril!

Results.ReviewText: Awesome. The only thing Weber should add is a better handle for the the lid vent.
Results.Title: Overall

Results.ReviewText: Awesome grill!  Great looking and easy to use. Best to brush when warm to get the most gunk off.  Great purchase.
Results.Title: Amazing grill

Results.ReviewText: This grill does what it’s supposed to do. It’s easy to clean. My only dilemma is that there is no latch to hold the cover when you remove the cover.
Results.Title: It’s a great grill!

Results.ReviewText:
A Daily cooker for the wife and i,
Not a typo, we eat "fresh" and the kettle allows for better tasting meals than any "indoor" kitchen can replicate, only in inclement weather or late work nights do we cook indoors,
Fantastic grill, the only brand the wife and have owned.
Cook your daily meals on it, you won't regret it
Results.Title: Daily cooker

Results.ReviewText: Would have given it 5 stars, but I have had a Weber gas grill for the last 15 years, and I’m still getting use to the Weber Charcoal Grill again.
Results.Title: Back to a Weber Charcoal Grill

Results.ReviewText: Fantastic grill, absolutely the best for the price. Our grill grate came with two bars bent, and customer service replaced it quickly.
Results.Title: Best charcoal grill on the market

Results.ReviewText: The Weber Kettle is AMAZING! Holds heat perfectly and performs at amazing capacity. Built nice and solid too. Truly this is great and everything I cook on this comes out FANTASTIC!
Results.Title: A MUST BUY!!!

Results.ReviewText: Love my Weber the rack is super easy to add more Charcoal, the temp gauge is so handy, and the ashbin is great and a clean up made easy. As a kid we got my Dad a Weber in the ‘60’s he loved it as I do.
Results.Title: My new Weber

Results.ReviewText: This grill is really good with grilling capacity and ease of use, cleaning is still a chore but the ash catcher makes it easier and cleaner- worth it
Results.Title: Good buy

Results.ReviewText:
This a good grill to use, and makes Sumer barbecues worth the Hot Days!
BUT Make sure you grab the extras - grill cover, Chimney, Gloves and Safe Brush. That’s what Makes the Grill Experience worth it!
Results.Title: Weber Grill - Buy It

Results.ReviewText: Works as described…. Great to work with charcoal again… easy to clean up
Results.Title: Great Buy

Results.ReviewText: The coal ash collector is all the rage. Works as demonstrated and you stay clean as well.
Results.Title: Coal Collector

Results.ReviewText: Easy to put together. Grills great but replaced the too widely spaced stock charcoal holding grate with an aftermarket that held fire starters & allowed mesquite irregular shaped charcoal
Results.Title: Great grill but bought aftermarket lower grate

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
